title: Pantry Expiry and Food-Waste Reduction
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pantry:item
| eval days_to_expiry=round((expiry_epoch-now())/86400,0)
| where days_to_expiry<7 AND quantity>0
| sort days_to_expiry
| table item days_to_expiry quantity
description: Lists the food nearing its use-by date so you can cook it first and throw less away.
value: Most household food waste is stuff forgotten at the back of a shelf; an eat-me-first list turns waste into dinner.
implementation: Record expiry dates with pantry items; schedule daily and surface everything due to expire this week.
visualization: Table of soon-to-expire items sorted by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which food is about to go off so you can use it up instead of binning it.
